notes: This is the one section that characterises the compound, so the characterisation fields are populated here. CAS number 335104-84-2 at [0003] line 82, molecular formula C17H16ClF3O6S at [0004] line 84 and molecular weight 440.88 at [0005] line 86 are all printed for this compound. CompoundRecord has no field for a formula or a molecular weight, so both are recorded here as printed and neither is placed in smiles, which stays null. The printed molecular weight 440.88 does not agree with the molecular formula printed two lines above it, which sums to a slightly lower value; both are recorded exactly as printed and neither is corrected, per rule 21. [0006] line 88 gives the appearance as 白色或类白色无定形粉末, which fixes appearance, color and physical_form. [0007] line 90 gives the melting point as a single printed value and not a range, so min_c and max_c are both that value and range_text keeps the printed phrase including the full-width colon and the single-character degree Celsius sign. The drawn structure of [0008], printed as an IMAGE_EXTRACT at line 92 before the [0008] marker at line 94, is 式1 and its SMILES matches the name, its 4-methanesulfonyl 3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl 2-chloro benzoyl group and its 2-substituted cyclohexane-1,3-dione, so the SMILES is an alias per rule 4b. is_section_product is true because [0009] and the scheme at [0010] make this compound the product the whole section is about. commercially_available is false per rule 11 because the Synthesis Scheme at [0029] and Example 6 at [0053] prepare it; the field answers whether a step of this document makes it and not whether it can be bought, and tembotrione is a marketed herbicide. This section prints 环磺酮 and the Latin tembotrione only, never the shortened 磺酮 that the abstract and [0026] print. The section does not say whether the route at [0009] and [0010] is prior art or the invention's own route; the vision pass read [0010] as prior art and the same route redrawn at [0031] as the invention route, and that disagreement is recorded here rather than resolved. Seen and deliberately not emitted as compounds: 对‑羟苯基丙酮酸双氧化酶 (HPPD) at line 80, an enzyme and the herbicide's target rather than a substance this patent handles; 三酮类 (triketone class) and 除草剂 (herbicide) at line 80, which are classes; the six weed species 蓟草, 田旋花, 婆婆纳, 辣子草, 鼬瓣花 and 猪殃殃 at line 80; and Ames at line 105, which is an assay. No sulcotrione and no mesotrione appear anywhere in this section, so no vision correction was missed here.

Named at [0006] line 88 only, in the statement 几乎不溶于乙醇 that tembotrione is almost insoluble in it, so this section by itself uses it in no step. role is nevertheless kept as solvent, unlike dichloromethane and toluene from the same sentence, because the rest of the document does make it a medium: 20%含水乙醇 is the dissolution medium of the purification in Example 2 batch 8, Example 4 batch 15 and Example 5, and 乙醇 is one of the four named components of the 含水溶液 in the claims and in [0017]. Those sections sort after background, so they would carry solvent into the merge in any case, and here the shared canonical value is followed rather than overridden because the document supports it. The three compounds of [0006] are therefore not treated alike, and the reason is the evidence outside this section and not the sentence they share. No quantity, no characterisation and no drawn structure, so those fields are null rather than objects whose members are all null.

notes: Named at [0009] line 95 as 苯甲酰氯, the acyl chloride formed from the benzoic acid and consumed by the cyclohexanedione. It is one Chinese character from the 苯甲酸 in the same sentence and the two are kept apart as two records. No SMILES alias: the scheme at [0010] line 97 collapses the two prose stages onto one arrow and never draws this intermediate, so it is named by prose only in this section and no drawn structure supports it. On this section's own evidence its role is both a product of the first stage and a reactant of the second; the shared canonical role reactant is used so the alphabetical merge does not decide it by filename, and this section's reading is recorded here. commercially_available is false per rule 11 because [0009] describes it being prepared from the benzoic acid, even though [0029] and [0053] charge it into the flask as a starting material; both facts are in the document and point opposite ways, and rule 11's test decides it. hazard:corrosive because an aroyl chloride plainly requires it; the patent prints no warning.

Named at [0009] line 95 only as 烯醇酯, a class phrase and not a compound name, so resolved is false and unresolved_reference is true. The patent never prints a full name for it anywhere. Its structure is nevertheless determined by the drawing: the scheme at [0010], line 97, gives it as the step 1 product and the step 2 reactant, the aryl ester of the enol of cyclohexane-1,3-dione, so that SMILES is an alias per rule 4b even though the identifier stays unresolved. The full name is drawable but never written, which is why this record is drawing-dependent and would be lost by a reader of the prose alone. role is product because it is the isolated product of the first stage; is_section_product is false because it is an intermediate and the section's own product is tembotrione. The [0032] variant spelling 烯醇脂, the patent's own typo, is outside this section and is not recorded here.

Named three times in this section and merged into one record per rule 4: at [0009] line 95 as the agent of the 重排反应 that gives tembotrione, in the step 2 condition text of the scheme at [0010] line 97 where it is drawn as a full structure above the arrow rather than written as a label, and at [0011] line 100 where the patent itself calls it 催化剂丙酮氰醇, the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. That printed phrase is kept as an alias. The patent's own word 催化剂 fixes role as catalyst here, which agrees with the shared canonical role. No SMILES alias: the scheme describes the drawn structure in words as (CH3)2C(OH)CN but the vision pass returned no SMILES for it, and rule 4b applies only to a SMILES actually read from the drawing. hazard:cyanide_handling because a cyanohydrin plainly requires it and because [0011] makes residual cyanide the problem the patent exists to solve; the patent prints no explicit warning.

Named at [0011], which straddles a page break: the sentence begins at line 100 and continues at line 105 with no marker reprinted, and the words 氰化物杂质 fall on the continuation line. resolved is false because this is a class and not one compound; the patent never says which cyanide species contaminates the product. unresolved_reference is false because it is a class term and not a back-reference to a compound named elsewhere in the document, which is what rule 6's local-label case covers. It is nevertheless the substance this whole patent exists to remove, so it has to be present in the artifact. role by_product because [0011] says the rearrangement produces it alongside the product. The Ames test named on line 105 is an assay and is not emitted as a compound and not recorded in analytics, whose method enum has no value for a mutagenicity assay; [0011] says the positive Ames result is caused by the residual cyanide impurity and is not an intrinsic property of tembotrione.
